Looping in technical notes so we can set expectations on the kickoff:

- Model & infra: For Lucent’s use-case (realtime customer responses + batch reranks), I recommend starting on the rdx-large-quantized variant for cost predictability; if latency needs tighten we can switch to rdx-xlarge on Dedicated.
- Performance validation: I can run a synthetic load for the 100k token/day target — I estimate aggregate QPS ~25 (depending on prompt lengths). We should decide on tokenization baseline during kickoff.
- Data paths: We'll need to validate egress rules for KV cache and S3 access; please share network contacts.

I’ll add a small tech appendix slide to the kickoff deck and be on the call.
